programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 21
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Sementara itu, Aqua diam-diam melanjutkan penyelidikannya terhadap sosok yang bertanggung jawab atas kematian Ai Hoshino, hingga menemukan petunjuk baru yang membawa penyelidikannya ke arah yang semakin berbahaya. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Konosuba S2, Ep 4
programme.desc: Kazuma Satou, seorang remaja yang meninggal dalam kecelakaan yang memalukan, bertemu dengan Dewi Aqua di alam setelah kematian. Ia diberi kesempatan untuk bereinkarnasi ke dunia fantasi dan memilih satu benda untuk dibawa. Sebagai balas dendam atas sikap Aqua yang mengejeknya, Kazuma justru memilih sang dewi untuk ikut bersamanya. Setibanya di dunia baru, keduanya segera menyadari bahwa kehidupan sebagai petualang tidak semudah yang dibayangkan. Episode pembuka ini memperkenalkan dunia penuh sihir, monster, dan humor satir yang menjadi ciri khas KonoSuba.

programme.title: Oshi No Ko S2, Ep 21
programme.desc: Musim kedua menghadirkan perjalanan Aqua, Ruby, Kana, Akane, dan para aktor lainnya dalam mempersiapkan adaptasi panggung Tokyo Blade. Di balik proses latihan dan pertunjukan, persaingan antarpemeran, tekanan untuk memberikan penampilan terbaik, serta dinamika hubungan pribadi menjadi tantangan yang harus mereka hadapi. Memadukan drama karakter yang emosional dengan gambaran realistis industri hiburan Jepang, musim ini menyajikan kisah tentang ambisi, pengorbanan, dan pencarian kebenaran.

programme.title: Cintaku Di Tangan Hansip
programme.desc: Yoga, seorang cowo yang lagi patah hati karena diputusin sama tunangannya berniat untuk bunuh diri dengan melompat dari jembatan. Tiba-tiba di belakang ia melihat rombongan orang yang lagi berlari, tepat paling depan ada cowo yang make baju yang sama seperti baju Yoga melemparkan sebuah tas ke arah Yoga. Yoga yang tadinya udah siap-siap loncat, menghentikan niatnya sesaat, dan memungut tas tersebut.

programme.title: Kau Ditakdirkan Untukku
programme.desc: Cerita tentang Alya, seorang gadis tangguh dan mandiri yang terlibat pernikahan kontrak dengan Devan, seorang pria kaya raya. Seiring waktu, hubungan yang semula hanya pura-pura perlahan berubah menjadi perasaan cinta yang tulus. Namun perjalanan mereka tidak semudah yang dibayangkan.

programme.title: Behind The Style
programme.desc: program yang kerap membahas tren gaya hidup dan mode.

programme.title: Runway
programme.desc: Setiap episodenya mengulas peragaan busana, tren fashion terbaru, serta gaya para desainer dan model ternama.

programme.title: Brothers Five
programme.desc: Seorang wanita muda bertekad untuk mempersatukan kakak beradik yang tengah berseteru, guna mengalahkan sekelompok pembunuh yang telah menghabisi nyawa ayah mereka.

programme.title: Lovers Blades
programme.desc: Film komedi ini bercerita tentang cinta terlarang dan senjata ajaib. Sepasang kekasih harus memperoleh kembali pedang titular dan membalas dendam atas pembunuhan yang terjadi di masa lalu mereka!

programme.title: The Merry Wife
programme.desc: Li Ching adalah gadis berumur 17 tahun yang menikahi gurunya yang berumur 35 tahun. Kelucuan terjadi ketika Li memutuskan untuk bersekolah di tempat sang suami bekerja dan berupaya menutupi hubungan mereka.

programme.title: Human Lanterns
programme.desc: Zhao pernah dikalahkan oleh Long dalam suatu duel. Tujuh tahun kemudian, Long meminta Zhao membuat sebuah lentera unik atas namanya untuk memenangkan kontes lentera. Zhao pun berencana untuk membalas dendam.

programme.title: Two Champions Of Shaolin
programme.desc: Berlatarkan era Dinasti Qing, film ini berkisah tentang klan Shaolin yang ingin menggulingkan Qing dan memulihkan Dinasti Ming, sementara klan Wudang didukung oleh pemerintah Qing.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: Moonlight Serenade
programme.desc: Dalam drama yang mengerikan ini, aktris populer Shaw Brothers, Li Jing, berperan sebagai putri pemilik penginapan di daerah pegunungan. Ia menyaksikan aksi pemerkosaan yang dilakukan oleh salah seorang penduduk.

programme.title: Brotherhood
programme.desc: Liu berupaya hidup terhormat dan mengabdi sebagai seorang anggota triad yang setia. Namun seiring berjalannya waktu, niat baik Liu membawanya ke dalam perang antargeng tanpa henti dengan dampak yang mengerikan.

programme.title: Mad Monkey Kung Fu
programme.desc: Seorang mantan ahli kung fu gaya monyet yang dikalahkan oleh seorang penjahat kejam diyakinkan oleh murid mudanya untuk mengajarinya kung fu gaya monyet demi membalas rasa malunya.

programme.title: The Thunderbolt Fist
programme.desc: Setelah Revolusi Tiongkok, penjajah Jepang mulai menyusup ke Timur Laut Tiongkok. Dalam film ini, Arashi Tani, seorang ahli judo yang jahat, ingin membuktikan bahwa orang-orang Tiongkok adalah bangsa Asia yang lemah.

programme.title: Blue Skies
programme.desc: Cheng Pei-pei berperan sebagai seorang penyanyi muda bernama Hsiao-Yun yang bimbang antara kesuksesannya dalam karier dan hubungannya dengan sang kekasih, seorang pianis bernama Li Yen-nan.

programme.title: Sons Of Good Earth
programme.desc: Film peraih penghargaan untuk naskah dan penyuntingan terbaik ini menceritakan kisah lain dari Perang Tiongkok-Jepang yang menggambarkan dengan jelas kehidupan masa perang secara artistik dan emosional.

programme.title: New Tales of the Flying Fox
Double Bliss
programme.desc: Ching Li berperan dalam kisah tentang dua pelajar yang berupaya membujuk orangtua mereka untuk merestui pernikahan mereka. Pasangan kekasih ini menjalankan sebuah rencana yang mereka kira mudah: berpura-pura mati!

programme.title: Dawn Will Come
programme.desc: Liang Cai memerkosa Qiu Rong dan berjanji akan menikahinya usai mendapat persetujuan orang tuanya. Namun, tak ada kabar lagi tentang pernikahan tersebut. Qiu pun mendesak Liang Cai saat menyadari bahwa dirinya hamil.

programme.title: Dream Of The Red Chamber
programme.desc: Pao-yu jatuh cinta pada sepupunya, Lin Tai-yu, tetapi keluarganya memiliki rencana pernikahan lain untuknya yang akan membuat keduanya patah hati.

programme.title: Look For A Star
programme.desc: Terinspirasi oleh hubungan antara Stanly Ho dan istri keempatnya, Angela, film ini adalah komedi romantis tentang seorang miliarder yang jatuh cinta dengan seorang dealer kasino yang bersemangat.

programme.title: Girl With The Diamond Slipper
programme.desc: Lily, adalah seorang gadis biasa yang menjalani kehidupan sederhana. Suatu hari, dalam sebuah pasar antik, dia menemukan sepasang sepatu kaca berlian yang indah. Tanpa disangka, sepatu ini ternyata memiliki kekuatan magis yang dapat mewujudkan impian dan memberikan keberuntungan. Ketika Lily mencoba sepatu tersebut, dia segera menemukan bahwa hidupnya mulai berubah drastis. Dia mendapatkan pekerjaan impiannya, bertemu dengan orang-orang penting, dan bahkan menarik perhatian seorang pangeran modern yang tampan.

programme.title: Confession Of Pain
programme.desc: Seorang detektif membantu temannya menyelidiki kematian misterius ayah mertuanya.

programme.title: The Great Magician
programme.desc: Seorang panglima perang Tiongkok menyewa seorang tukang sihir untuk membantunya mengesankan selirnya yang menolak.

programme.title: Detrimental
programme.desc: Seorang pria tunanetra, You Ji Ren, bekerja di sebuah pabrik di pulau terpencil. Karena badai, pabrik itu terisolasi dan muncul sesosok monster yang membuat siapa pun berubah menjadi bayangan hitam jika melihatnya.

programme.title: Young Ip Man: Crisis Time
programme.desc: Seluruh sekolah disandera saat kompetisi pidato bahasa Inggris berlangsung. Ip Man pun memutuskan untuk bangkit dan menghadapi krisis, serta menemukan bahwa dalangnya adalah sang guru dan teman masa kecilnya.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: Seorang imigran Tionghoa sederhana melancarkan perang berbahaya melawan salah satu organisasi kriminal paling kuat di planet ini.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: Endless Love
programme.desc: Seorang gadis muda bertemu dengan seorang novelis di sebuah bar dan langsung jatuh cinta padanya. Namun, ternyata ia malah terperangkap ke dalam jebakan yang direkayasa oleh si novelis dan mantan kekasihnya.

programme.title: The Accidental Spy
programme.desc: Di sebuah pusat perbelanjaan di Hong Kong, intuisi Buck Yuen (Jackie Chan) memperingatkannya. Ia menyelamatkan hasil rampasan perampokan dan muncul di televisi, akhirnya sampai di Istanbul melalui Korea Selatan, dan tanpa sengaja menjadi mata-mata. Untungnya, ia menguasai Kung Fu.

programme.title: Mr. Possessed
programme.desc: Riley diberi kemampuan untuk menahan godaan dari lawan jenis namun hal itu menjadi beban ketika ia hendak menikahi kekasihnya.

programme.title: Initial D
programme.desc: Selama lima tahun, Takumi yang berusia 18 tahun mengirimkan tahu setiap pagi dengan mengendarai Toyota AE86 kuno milik ayahnya. Ia pun mengembangkan teknik balap yang sempurna dan menjadi pembalap hebat.

programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: Seorang pengusaha serakah dari Hong Kong menyewa seorang pemburu muda untuk menangkap gorila raksasa yang konon hidup jauh di dalam hutan India. Pemburu itu menemukan kera tersebut, dan hidup bersamanya ia menemukan seorang wanita liar yang telah berteman dengan makhluk itu.

programme.title: Song Of The Assassins
programme.desc: Seorang pembunuh mengemban misi pertamanya sambil diam-diam menyelidiki penyebab pembantaian keluarganya beberapa tahun silam. Namun, ia malah terjerat dalam suatu konspirasi politik saat menjalankan misi.

programme.title: Mr. Virgin
programme.desc: Ketika seorang pemuda mengabaikan peringatan seorang ahli feng shui dan memutuskan untuk menikah sebelum berusia 30 tahun, serangkaian kesialan mulai mengutuk hidupnya.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi dan PI Lam mencuri dua plat USD100 yang dicuri di Hong Kong. Lam kehilangan mereka - tidak ada hadiah dari AS. Lam dan ketiga malaikat kecilnya mencoba mendapatkannya kembali di Seoul, begitu pula JJ. Banyak pertarungan.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: Setelah menyergap dan membunuh musuh bebuyutannya, namun kehilangan segalanya dalam proses itu, panglima perang Hou Jie yang putus asa mencari penebusan dengan berlindung di sebuah biara Shaolin.

programme.title: AfterDeath
programme.desc: Akibat tragedi yang terjadi di klub malam, lima orang korban tewas terbangun di sebuah pantai. Takut dan bingung, mereka mencoba memahami berbagai hal dan bertanya-tanya apakah mereka sungguh sedang berada di neraka.

programme.title: Burial Ground Massacre
programme.desc: Sekelompok mahasiswa menghabiskan malam di sebuah rumah besar tua yang menyeramkan, hanya untuk menyadari bahwa seorang penguntit yang mengerikan sedang mengawasi setiap gerakan mereka saat ia memulai rencana untuk mengambil alih artefak penduduk asli Amerika kuno yang ada di dalamnya.

programme.title: American Muscle
programme.desc: Setelah menjalani masa tahanan selama 10 tahun, seorang mantan narapidana memiliki waktu 24 jam untuk membalas dendam pada orang-orang yang memasukkannya ke dalam penjara.

programme.title: The Devil's Tomb
programme.desc: Sebuah kelompok tentara elit melakukan misi rahasia untuk menyelamatkan seorang ilmuwan dari makhluk jahat yang mendiami laboratorium bawah tanah.

programme.title: Look Away
programme.desc: Kehidupan seorang siswi SMA yang dikucilkan bernama Maria berubah drastis usai bertukar posisi dengan bayangan cerminnya yang jahat.

programme.title: Tucker And Dale Vs Evil
programme.desc: Liburan Tucker dan Dale di pegunungan berubah menjadi pengalaman mengerikan ketika mereka diserang oleh sekelompok mahasiswa dan dikira sebagai pembunuh gergaji mesin yang kejam.

programme.title: Riot
programme.desc: Polisi Jack Stone merampok bank mafia Rusia dan berakhir di penjara yang sama dengan bos mafia yang membunuh istri Jack. Seorang narapidana membantunya dan begitu pula seorang reporter. Banyak perkelahian.

programme.title: Among The Shadows
programme.desc: Seorang detektif swasta harus mengungkap pembunuhan pamannya sambil menjaga rahasia bahwa dia adalah keturunan manusia serigala.

programme.title: Born To Dance
programme.desc: Tu adalah seorang pemuda ambisius yang bermimpi menjadi penari hip-hop profesional. Kala sang ayah melarangnya, ia malah memutuskan untuk menjadikan tarian sebagai jalan hidupnya.

programme.title: Murder Syndicate
programme.desc: Ketika matriark dari sebuah keluarga pembunuh bayaran jatuh sakit, ketiga anaknya dan pacarnya yang lebih muda saling berebut untuk mengambil alih kerajaan bisnisnya.

programme.title: American Rider
programme.desc: Dua pengendara sepeda motor berangkat dari LA menuju New Orleans melalui daerah terbuka dan padang gurun, dan di sepanjang jalan mereka bertemu dengan seorang pria yang menjembatani kesenjangan budaya tandingan yang sebelumnya tidak mereka ketahui.

programme.title: Kruel
programme.desc: Kruel adalah film horor thriller tentang seorang pembunuh psikotik yang menyamar sebagai penjual es krim untuk lebih dekat dengan korban yang ia incar.

programme.desc: Berawal dari lahirnya rayyanza malik ahmad (cipung), putra kedua dari raffi ahmad dan nagita slavina yang membawa kebahagiaan untuk semua orang, bahkan sepupunya zayn dan zuney. Namun, berbeda dengan Rafathar, si anak sulung, dia justru cemburu karena merasa seluruh perhatian diambil oleh cipung. hingga keajaiban terjadi saat Fairy dust mengenai cipung, rafathar, Zayn, dan Zuney. Fairy dust mengubah para bayi menjadi bayi-bayi ajaib dan membawa mereka ke dunia boba, tempat untuk anak-anak di mana semua keajaiban bisa terjadi dan tanpa diketahui orang dewasa. Sejak saat itulah petualangan dimulai. Bersama para boba, makhluk yang bekerja di sana, mereka menciptakan alatalat ajaib hingga bertemu berbagai makhluk menakjubkan seperti monster tauge, para virus, zombie, manusia salju, hingga bertemu supercool yang meningkatkan adrenalin petualangan mereka.

programme.title: Rainbow Bubblegem
programme.desc: Rainbow Bubblegem

programme.title: RAINBOW BUBBLEGEM
programme.desc: Di dunia bawah laut, putri duyung bernama purple merindukan petualangan di daratan dan secara diam-diam mengambil risiko besar dengan mengubah dirinya menjadi manusia. Dengan bantuan pink star, peri penjaga bubblegem yang sedang tertidur, purple berubah wujud. Namun, penggunaan sihir yang berlebihan menyebabkan bubblegem, sumber kekuatan mereka, terpotong dan tersebar di daratan. untuk mengumpulkan kembali bubblegem yang tersebar, ratu laut white gold memerintahkan tujuh putri duyung dari kerajaan laut yang berbeda.

programme.title: Sunny Girl
programme.desc: Sunny Girl

programme.title: SUNNY GIRL NO.23
programme.desc: SUNNY GIRL NO.23 BUKAN HANYA TENTANG PERJALANAN PERTUMBUHAN SEORANG GADIS CERIA, TETAPI JUGA SERIAL ANIMASI BERTEMA REALISTIS PERTAMA YANG MENCERMINKAN PENDIDIKAN ORANGTUA-ANAK DAN KEHIDUPAN SEKOLAH DI TIONGKOK. TOKOH UTAMANYA ADALAH SEORANG SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR BERUSIA 8 TAHUN. DIA TIDAK LUAR BIASA. DIA ADALAH SEORANG GADIS DENGAN KARAKTER CEROBOH TETAPI DIA ADALAH GADIS YANG ENERGIK, OPTIMIS, DAN BAIK HATI YANG BERBAKAT DALAM MENGGAMBAR DENGAN KREATIVITAS DAN MEMILIKI KEMAMPUAN DALAM MEMECAHKAN MASALAH, YANG DAPAT DITEMUKAN OLEH SEBAGIAN BESAR ANAK-ANAK. ANIMASI INI DISUKAI OLEH PENONTON DI TIONGKOK DARATAN, DAN TELAH DIDISTRIBUSIKAN KE ASIA TENGGARA TERMASUK MALAYSIA DAN VIETNAM. MUSIM PERTAMA MENGEKSPRESIKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA DENGAN 26 CERITA LUCU, YAITU "ADA BEGITU BANYAK BENTUK KEUNGGULAN YANG BERBEDA, SETIAP ANAK UNGGUL DENGAN KELEBIHANNYA", TIDAK HANYA MENGHADIRKAN MASA KECIL SISWA SEKOLAH DASAR KONTEMPORER, TETAPI JUGA BENTURAN ANTARA KONSEP PENGASUHAN LAMA DAN BARU. MUSIM KEDUA MEMBAWA DAN MENINGKATKAN PANDANGAN DUNIA INI.

programme.desc: Serial madun menceritakan perjalanan hidup madun (16 tahun) dalam memperjuangkan cita-citanya menjadi pesepakbola. Ayahnya, syafei (50 tahun) keturunan medan sangat menginginkan anaknya menjadi ustadz. Karena itu. Syafei selalu menghalangi upaya madun mencapai cita-citanya itu. baginya, pilihan madun hanya satu. Yakni jadi ahli agama. Ibunya madun, yaitu kirana asli batavia serba salah, dia harus patuh pada suami anti bola. Namun di sisi lain ia juga tidak ingin menghalangi madun mewujudkan cita-citanya. programme.title: The Marsupilamis
programme.desc: Marsupilami yang legendaris meninggalkan hutan belantara Palombia dan pindah ke tempat yang lebih liar lagi: kota. Di sana, si kembar Jade dan Mica mendapati dunia mereka terbalik ketika orang tua mereka yang seorang penjelajah mempercayakan tiga telur Marsupilami misterius kepada mereka. Setelah menetas, kedua saudara ini harus kreatif untuk menyembunyikan teman-teman baru mereka—lagipula, tidak ada yang tahu keberadaan makhluk-makhluk energik ini, dan predator bisa saja mengintai di setiap sudut.

Namun dengan kebaikan hati Andien, perlahan Aldebaran melihat kebenaran dan mulai jatuh cinta pada Andien

programme.title: Ikatan Cinta Aldebaran & Andin
programme.desc: Kompilasi perjalanan cinta Aldebaran dan Andin yang penuh lika-liku, mulai dari kesalahpahaman, pengorbanan, hingga perjuangan mempertahankan keluarga.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Ternyata Ini Cinta
programme.desc: Setelah sebuah kecelakaan merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap liar. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi kisah cinta, hingga rahasia mengenai status anak angkatnya dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran di balik kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Ternyata Ini Cinta (RCTI)
programme.desc: Usai kecelakaan yang merenggut nyawa ayahnya, Luna kembali ke dunia balap jalanan. Persaingannya dengan Marco berubah menjadi cinta, hingga rahasia adopsi dan geng Spider mengungkap kebenaran kematian sang ayah.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terikat Janji
programme.desc: Davina Rosalia Kusuma, putri pengusaha, tampak hidup sempurna namun menyimpan luka sejak ibunya meninggal dan ayahnya menikah lagi. Ia merasa terasing, terlebih setelah cinta pertamanya, Ryan, menghilang. Sepuluh tahun kemudian, pertunangannya dengan Dipa hancur karena perselingkuhan dengan adik tirinya, Jihan. Di tengah keterpurukan, Davina bertemu Sena, penjual ketoprak yang ternyata polisi intel yang menyelidiki Dipa. Davina meminta Sena berpura-pura menjadi pacarnya, namun hubungan palsu itu berubah menjadi nyata. Tanpa ia tahu, Sena juga mencari kebenaran tentang hilangnya Ryanmembawa mereka pada rahasia, balas dendam, dan perasaan yang tak terduga.

programme.title: Terikat Janji (RCTI)
programme.desc: Davina terluka karena pengkhianatan cinta dan hidupnya hancur. Ia kemudian menjalin hubungan pura-pura dengan Sena. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keduanya benar-benar jatuh cinta, namun harus menghadapi rahasia dan konflik keluarga yang rumit.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia : Terlanjur Mencintaimu
programme.desc: Arumi, seorang barista keliling pekerja keras, menikah dengan Rendi, namun kemudian mengetahui bahwa pria itu sudah beristri dan hanya memanfaatkannya demi mendapatkan pewaris. Sempat mengira bayinya telah meninggal, ia akhirnya mengungkap kebenaran dan menemukan harapan baru bersama Elio.

programme.title: Terlanjur Mencintaimu (RCTI)
programme.desc: Arumi, barista keliling, menikahi Rendi yang ternyata telah beristri dan memanfaatkannya demi keturunan. Setelah bayinya dikira meninggal, Arumi mengungkap fakta mengejutkan. Di tengah luka, ia menemukan harapan bersama Elio.

programme.title: Layar Drama RCTI - Bidadari Bermata Bening
programme.desc: Dalam usahanya mengejar cinta dan impian, Ayna menghadapi berbagai tantangan serta pilihan tak terduga di antara Gus Afif, Yoyok, dan Anton, sembari harus menghadapi rencana orang lain bagi hidupnya.

programme.title: Bidadari Bermata Bening
programme.desc: Dalam mengejar cinta dan impiannya, Ayna menghadapi tantangan dan pilihan tak terduga di antara Gus Afif, Yoyok, dan Anton, sembari berhadapan dengan rencana orang lain untuk hidupnya.

programme.title: Layar Drama Indonesia Malam - Cinta Dari Surga (Rr)
programme.desc: Menceritakan kisah hidup dan percintaan gadis desa bernama Cinta yang menghadapi peliknya perbedaan status sosial serta intrik cinta segitiga. Semua berawal setelah Cinta mengalami insiden kecelakaan dan musibah yang membuatnya kehilangan barang-barang serta keluarganya di Jakarta. Di tengah keterpurukan, Revan pria dari kota dengan latar belakang kayadatang menolong dan selalu ada untuk Cinta. Hubungan Cinta dan Revan tidak berjalan mulus karena ibunda Revan menentang keras kedekatan mereka akibat perbedaan status sosial yang mencolok.

programme.title: Cinta Dari Surga

programme.title: Back To The Future 3
programme.desc: Terdampar di tahun 1955, Marty McFly mengetahui kematian Doc Brown di tahun 1885 dan harus kembali ke masa lalu untuk menyelamatkannya. Tanpa bahan bakar yang tersedia untuk DeLorean, keduanya harus mencari cara untuk melarikan diri dari Old West sebelum Emmett dibunuh.

programme.desc: Program gelar wicara berbasis berita. Dibawakan oleh Azizah Hanum, berbagai topik terhangat serta sisi lain kehidupan dan karir para pejabat pemerintah, figur publik dan tokoh politik Indonesia disajikan dalam bentuk obrolan berbobot dari sudut pandang orang yang bersangkutan.

programme.title: Halo Selebriti
programme.desc: Acara ini menampilkan kabar seputar kehidupan selebriti, mulai dari aktivitas, prestasi, hingga gosip terkini yang sedang menjadi sorotan publik.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: Mommy Says
programme.desc: Mommy Says adalah program talk show gaya hidup dari Sanlih E-Television yang dipandu oleh Lin Shu-wei. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. Bersama para ahli dan bintang tamu, acara ini menghadirkan informasi praktis, inspiratif, dan mudah diterapkan untuk membantu pemirsa menjalani kehidupan yang lebih sehat, percaya diri, dan berkualitas.

programme.title: Hot Door Night
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Hot Door Night merupakan salah satu acara variety paling populer di Taiwan. Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

Dipandu oleh Jacky Wu bersama Chen Han-Dian dan Lulu Huang, setiap episode menghadirkan bintang tamu dari dunia hiburan untuk mengikuti berbagai permainan kreatif, tantangan bertema, penampilan musik, hingga segmen komedi yang mengundang tawa. Dengan perpaduan hiburan, kompetisi, dan interaksi spontan antar selebritas, acara ini telah menjadi favorit pemirsa serta meraih berbagai penghargaan bergengsi, termasuk Golden Bell Awards.

programme.title: Stylish Man: The Chef
programme.desc: Stylish Man: The Chef adalah salah satu program memasak paling populer di Taiwan yang telah menghibur pemirsa sejak 2006. Dipandu oleh Sam Tseng dan Genie Chuo bersama chef profesional James dan Wu Bing-Cheng, setiap episode menghadirkan demonstrasi memasak, kompetisi kuliner, tantangan bertema, serta kehadiran bintang tamu dari kalangan selebritas. Selain menyuguhkan hiburan yang ringan dan penuh humor, acara ini juga membagikan berbagai resep, teknik memasak, dan tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan di rumah.

programme.title: New Taiwan Online
programme.desc: New Taiwan Online merupakan program diskusi berita dari Sanlih News yang menghadirkan ulasan mendalam mengenai berbagai isu terkini di Taiwan maupun dunia. Dipandu oleh Hsu Kuei-ya, acara ini mengangkat topik politik, ekonomi, hubungan internasional, hingga isu sosial yang sedang menjadi perhatian publik. Setiap episode membahas berbagai topik yang dekat dengan kehidupan sehari-hari, mulai dari perawatan kecantikan, tren busana, kesehatan, parenting, hingga tips menjadi konsumen yang cerdas. Bersama para ahli dan bintang tamu, acara ini menghadirkan informasi praktis, inspiratif, dan mudah diterapkan untuk membantu pemirsa menjalani kehidupan yang lebih sehat, percaya diri, dan berkualitas.

programme.title: The Sound Of Happiness
programme.desc: The Sound of Happiness mengisahkan keluarga Wu yang dipimpin oleh seorang perwira polisi beserta istrinya. Meski awalnya berharap memiliki seorang putra, mereka justru dikaruniai empat anak perempuan yang masing-masing menghadapi perjalanan hidup dan kisah cinta yang berbeda. Seiring berjalannya waktu, keluarga ini harus menghadapi berbagai konflik, mulai dari perselingkuhan, persaingan, ambisi, hingga rahasia yang menguji hubungan mereka. Di tengah berbagai cobaan tersebut, kasih sayang keluarga dan tekad untuk saling melindungi menjadi kekuatan utama dalam menghadapi setiap tantangan kehidupan.

programme.title: The Tradition Story Of Taiwan
programme.desc: The Tradition Story of Taiwan menyajikan berbagai kisah legenda, cerita rakyat, adat istiadat, kepercayaan tradisional, dan sejarah lokal yang membentuk identitas budaya Taiwan. Setiap episode mengungkap asal-usul tradisi, tokoh legendaris, perayaan budaya, hingga nilai-nilai yang diwariskan dari generasi ke generasi. Dengan perpaduan narasi, kunjungan ke lokasi bersejarah, dan eksplorasi budaya masyarakat setempat, program ini menghadirkan wawasan mendalam mengenai kekayaan warisan budaya Taiwan.

programme.title: Taste Of Life
programme.desc: Taste of Life mengisahkan keluarga Zhao, pemilik usaha kecap tradisional yang telah diwariskan selama beberapa generasi. Ketika sang kepala keluarga mulai mencari penerus usahanya, setiap anggota keluarga dihadapkan pada pilihan sulit antara mempertahankan tradisi atau mengejar ambisi pribadi. Di tengah konflik bisnis, kisah cinta, perselingkuhan, pengorbanan, dan rahasia keluarga, mereka belajar bahwa kebersamaan, ketekunan, dan kasih sayang adalah fondasi utama untuk menghadapi setiap tantangan hidup.

Dikemas secara interaktif dan menghibur, acara ini memberikan inspirasi sekaligus tips praktis yang dapat diterapkan dalam kehidupan sehari-hari.

programme.title: Girls Tease
programme.desc: Diproduksi oleh Sanlih E-Television, Girls Tease adalah program talk show yang mengangkat berbagai topik seputar kehidupan perempuan masa kini. Dipandu oleh Tien Hsin dan Fabien Yang, setiap episode menghadirkan selebritas, pakar, serta perwakilan masyarakat untuk berbagi pengalaman dan berdiskusi mengenai tren kecantikan, fashion, percintaan, karier, kesehatan, hingga berbagai tantangan yang dihadapi perempuan urban. Dikemas dengan suasana santai, interaktif, dan penuh humor, acara ini menyuguhkan informasi sekaligus hiburan yang relevan bagi penonton modern.

programme.title: Top Singers
programme.desc: Top Singers menghadirkan para penyanyi berbakat yang menunjukkan kemampuan vokal dan gaya musik mereka melalui berbagai penampilan menarik. Setiap episode menampilkan interpretasi lagu-lagu populer, kisah perjalanan musik para penyanyi, serta momen spesial yang memperlihatkan bakat dan karakter unik masing-masing artis. Program ini menjadi wadah apresiasi bagi para musisi dan pecinta musik.

programme.title: Show Biz
programme.desc: Show Biz menghadirkan berbagai informasi terkini seputar industri hiburan, mulai dari kabar selebritas, film, serial televisi, musik, hingga gaya hidup. Program ini juga menyuguhkan liputan di balik layar, wawancara eksklusif dengan para artis, serta ulasan mengenai tren dan peristiwa terbaru di dunia entertainment. Dengan penyajian yang ringan dan informatif, Show Biz menjadi sumber informasi bagi penonton yang ingin mengikuti perkembangan industri hiburan.

programme.title: Love Now
programme.desc: Love Now mengisahkan Yang Yi Ru, seorang eksekutif periklanan yang terlalu fokus pada pekerjaannya hingga membuat keluarga dan sahabatnya khawatir. Demi memaksanya beristirahat, mereka membuatnya percaya bahwa usianya tidak akan lama lagi. Dalam perjalanan yang dijalaninya, Yi Ru bertemu Lan Shi De dan perlahan menjalin hubungan yang penuh kehangatan. Di tengah berbagai kesalahpahaman, konflik keluarga, dan tantangan hidup, keduanya belajar tentang arti cinta, kepercayaan, dan pentingnya menghargai setiap momen dalam kehidupan.

Melalui pengalaman seru, interaksi yang menghibur, dan rekomendasi perjalanan yang praktis, program ini memberikan inspirasi wisata bagi para penonton.

programme.title: DRAZILION
programme.desc: Drazilion mengisahkan petualangan Oli, Emma, Fabio, dan Rachel yang menjelajahi dunia fantasi bernama Virmark. Berbekal rasa ingin tahu dan semangat petualangan, mereka berusaha menemukan Drazilion, makhluk legendaris yang diyakini sebagai induk dari seluruh makhluk yang hidup di dunia tersebut. Sepanjang perjalanan, mereka bertemu berbagai spesies unik, menghadapi tantangan yang tidak terduga, serta memecahkan masalah bersama. Setiap petualangan mengajarkan nilai-nilai penting seperti keberanian, persahabatan, kerja sama, dan kepedulian terhadap lingkungan. programme.title: L'ABÎME
programme.desc: L'Abîme mengisahkan Laurent Lacaze yang harus menghadapi kenyataan pahit setelah istrinya, Elsa, menghilang secara misterius. Awalnya diduga sebagai kasus orang hilang biasa, penyelidikan justru mengungkap bahwa Elsa bukanlah sosok yang selama ini dikenal oleh keluarga maupun orang-orang di sekitarnya. Saat berbagai rahasia masa lalu mulai terkuak, Laurent berusaha menyusun kepingan-kepingan misteri demi menemukan istrinya dan melindungi putri mereka. Pencarian tersebut membawanya pada jaringan kebohongan, identitas tersembunyi, dan ancaman yang semakin berbahaya, menjadikan kisah ini perpaduan antara thriller psikologis, misteri, dan drama keluarga yang penuh ketegangan.

programme.desc: Jad et ses soeurs mengisahkan kehidupan sehari-hari Jad bersama dua saudara kembarnya, Ranya dan Syrine. Dalam setiap episode, mereka menghadapi berbagai situasi yang dekat dengan dunia anak-anak, mulai dari kegiatan sekolah, permainan bersama teman, perjalanan keluarga, hingga tantangan kecil yang mengajarkan nilai-nilai kehidupan. Dikemas dengan humor dan cerita yang hangat, serial ini mengajarkan pentingnya kerja sama, rasa hormat, tanggung jawab, serta kasih sayang dalam keluarga.

programme.title: COMPOSTMAN ET MOI
programme.desc: Compostman et Moi adalah dokumenter yang mengisahkan perjalanan Florian Bonnet, seorang aktivis lingkungan yang dikenal dengan julukan "Compostman". Dengan semangat mengurangi limbah makanan dan meningkatkan kesadaran akan pentingnya pengelolaan sampah organik, ia berkeliling menemui berbagai komunitas untuk memperkenalkan manfaat pengomposan. Melalui kisah-kisah inspiratif, inisiatif masyarakat, dan penjelasan mengenai dampak positif pengomposan terhadap lingkungan, dokumenter ini menunjukkan bagaimana tindakan sederhana sehari-hari dapat membantu mengurangi sampah, memperbaiki kualitas tanah, dan mendukung gaya hidup yang lebih ramah lingkungan.

programme.desc: On their one-year anniversary, sous chef Tom Solomon (Jason Segel) plans to surprise his girlfriend, Violet Barnes (Emily Blunt), with an engagement ring. The lovers do end up engaged, but the fact that the proposal does not go exactly as planned proves to be a harbinger of things to come. Each time they try to set a date, various obstacles stand in their way. As more and more time passes, Tom and Violet begin to wonder if perhaps their marriage is not meant to be.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: Ever since a vicious attack nearly claimed her life, Christine Lucas (Nicole Kidman) has suffered from anterograde amnesia and is unable to form new memories. Every morning, she becomes reacquainted with her husband, Ben (Colin Firth), and the other constants in her life. In accordance with her doctor's (Mark Strong) instructions, Christine keeps a video diary. As Christine starts to uncover terrifying truths about her past, she begins to question everything -- and everyone -- around her.

programme.desc: With time running out before the Grand Opening celebration for the new Marketplace, Strawberry's friends get the idea to invite her favorite singer, superstar CHERRY JAM, to be the guest singer. Strawberry is touched by their surprise, but reminds them that now the town and Marketplace really have to shine!

programme.title: Heathers [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Veronica (Winona Ryder) is part of the most popular clique at her high school, but she disapproves of the other girls' cruel behavior. When Veronica and her new boyfriend, J.D. (Christian Slater), confront clique leader Heather Chandler (Kim Walker) and accidentally poison her, they make it appear a suicide. Soon Veronica realizes that J.D. is intentionally killing students he does not like. She races to stop J.D. while also clashing with the clique's new leader, Heather Duke (Shannen Doherty).

programme.title: Honest Thief
programme.desc: Wanting to lead an honest life, a notorious bank robber (Liam Neeson) turns himself in, only to be double-crossed by two ruthless FBI agents.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. As he tries to figure out what his next step should be, he finds himself in Miami. Carl joins forces with his ex-wife (Sofía Vergara), best friend (John Leguizamo) and son (Emjay Anthony) to launch a food-truck business, and the venture provides a chance to reignite his passion for cooking -- as well as his zest for life and love.

programme.title: Gang of Roses
programme.desc: A gang of gold-hunting outlaws, headed by the ruthless Left Eye Watkins (Bobby Brown), takes over the peaceful town of Flatridge, tearing the sleepy outpost to shreds as they search for riches. They murder a can-can girl, who is the sister of Rachel (Monica Calhoun), the onetime leader of a notorious all-girl gang. Rachel then rounds up her four old associates, and they seek revenge for her sister. Using teamwork and a sassy attitude, Rachel's gang goes up against Watkins' tough crew.

programme.title: The Code
programme.desc: A veteran thief recruits a younger crook to help him pull off one final job in order to repay his debt to the Russian mob.

programme.title: Gerry [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Friends Gerry (Casey Affleck) and Gerry (Matt Damon) hike into Death Valley, but they stray so far from the trail that they have no idea how to get back. Initially, they maintain morale by rehashing old stories and reciting inside jokes, but the gravity of their situation sinks in as a return to civilization becomes more unlikely. As the sheer scope, hypnotic pull and spirit-crushing mirages of the desert affect the men, their will to live and sense of identity is challenged and transformed.

programme.title: Hit & Run [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Charlie Bronson (Dax Shepard), a nice guy with a shady past as a getaway driver, breaks out of the witness protection program in a backwater California town to drive his girlfriend, Annie (Kristen Bell), to Los Angeles for an important job interview. The pair's road trip takes an awkward and dangerous turn when they find that an inept federal agent (Tom Arnold) and the mobster (Bradley Cooper) he testified against are both trying to hunt them down.

programme.title: Kill Switch
programme.desc: A psychopathic killer is ravaging Memphis, Tennesse by murdering young women and Detective Jacob Stillwell is on the case. Known as the resident tough cop due to his aggressive tactics, he gets knocked sideways when his girlfriend becomes one of the murder victims. With his partner, Storm Anderson, in tow, Jacob casts the rules aside and infiltrates the seedy criminal underworld of the city looking to avenge his lover's death and put an end to the killings.

programme.title: All I See Is You [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Gina is a beautiful young woman who's still haunted by the accident that took her sight years earlier. Living in Bangkok with her husband, James, she undergoes a cutting-edge operation that restores the vision to her right eye. Now that Gina can see again, she slowly starts to realize that her newfound independence makes James feel jealous, threatened and insecure.

programme.title: Hunt for the Wilderpeople
programme.desc: A misfit kid and his foster uncle go on the run in the New Zealand bush, evading child services and the law.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Blitz
programme.desc: Jason Statham stars as a tough cop who's dispatched to take down a serial killer who has been targeting police officers. Also featuring Paddy Considine and Aidan Gillen.

programme.title: Blind Horizon [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Found in the New Mexico desert with a head wound and total amnesia, Frank Kavanaugh (Val Kilmer) is brought to a hospital. When he recovers some of his memory, he begins raving about an upcoming assassination attempt on the president. Despite the man's unstable state, Sheriff Jack Kolb (Sam Shepard) is troubled by Frank's story. Discovering the truth grows more complicated when Chloe Richards (Neve Campbell) arrives and claims to be Frank's fiancée, even though he has no memory of her.

programme.title: 10th & Wolf [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: While serving in the military, a Marine sergeant (James Marsden) believes his family's ties to organized crime are a thing of the past. However, an act of insubordination and a visit from the F.B.I. send him packing to his South Philadelphia hometown, and he discovers that his brother (Brad Renfro) and his cousin (Giovanni Ribisi) have become entangled with mobsters, leaving him with only one way to save them.

programme.title: I'm Charlie Walker [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: In 1971 two oil tankers collide off the coast of San Francisco, spilling millions of gallons of crude oil and creating an environmental disaster. Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. However, he also finds himself fighting institutional racism from the very company that hired him.

programme.title: Are You Here
programme.desc: In this touching dramedy, weatherman Steve (Owen Wilson) must join his off-the-grid best friend Ben (Zach Galifianakis) for Ben's estranged father's funeral.

programme.title: My Baby Gone
programme.desc: Pregnant Emily bonds quickly with her pregnant neighbor Kelly, but Kelly is faking it and plans to steal Emily's baby.

programme.title: Animal Factory [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Suburbanite Ron (Edward Furlong) is spoiled, young and not overly worried about the marijuana charges leveled against him. But, after being made out to be a drug dealer, he faces a five-year jail sentence in San Quentin State Prison. Physically frail and unaccustomed to his rough surroundings, Ron is primed to fall victim to sexual predators and bullying guards -- that is, until he's befriended by Earl (Willem Dafoe), a veteran inmate who finds meaning in protecting the vulnerable new kid.

programme.title: Going All The Way [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Korean War--era veterans and ex-classmates "Gunner" Casselman (Ben Affleck) and "Sonny" Burns (Jeremy Davies) reunite upon their return home. Gunner, who spent the war years abroad, is trying to convince his mother that his gal Marty (Rachel Weisz) is good enough for him, while Sonny, who was stationed stateside, is torn between loyal Buddy (Amy Locane) and tempting Gale Ann (Rose McGowan). As they commiserate, the men realize that they're outgrowing the lives they lived before the war.

programme.title: Chef [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: After a controlling owner (Dustin Hoffman) pushes him too far, chef Carl Casper (Jon Favreau) quits his position at a prestigious Los Angeles restaurant. programme.title: Direct Contact
programme.desc: An American prisoner in a Russian jail is given a chance at freedom if he can rescue a kidnapped woman.

programme.title: The Long Walk Home
programme.desc: Odessa Cotter needs to get to work as a nanny in the home of the affluent Miriam Thompson, but she refuses to take the bus. Odessa is participating in the Montgomery bus boycott, protesting against the inequality between blacks and whites, so Miriam decides to offer Odessa a ride to work every day. Though the community and Miriam's husband insist she not get involved, the relationship between Miriam and Odessa has already changed for the better.

programme.title: Cold Blood
programme.desc: A legendary retired hit man (Jean Reno) lives in isolation in the barren North American wilderness. When he rescues a woman from a snowmobiling accident, he soon discovers that she's harboring a secret that forces him to return to his lethal ways.

programme.title: Homeboy [Broadcast Edit]
programme.desc: Though only in his 20s, professional boxer Johnny Walker is on the downswing of his career and suffering from a mild form of brain damage. Resettling in the beachfront resort of Asbury Park, N.J., he falls in with shady promoter Wesley Pendergass and meets kindhearted boardwalk operator Ruby. When Wesley proposes cutting Johnny in on a criminal undertaking, Johnny must choose between a life of crime and a settled future with Ruby.

programme.title: She-Devil
programme.desc: Housewife and mother Ruth Patchett (Roseanne Barr), an overweight and unkempt woman, can seem to do nothing to make her husband, Bob (Ed Begley Jr.), happy. When he becomes embroiled in an affair with romance novelist Mary Fisher (Meryl Streep), Patchett does all she can to ignore it until Bob finally leaves her for Fisher. Bent on revenge, Patchett begins an intricate undertaking that will lead to the destruction of all that Bob holds dear -- and she also has plans for Fisher while she's at it.

programme.title: The Grudge 3
programme.desc: Jake (Matthew Knight), who nearly lost his mind after battling a vicious Japanese curse, is living in a mental hospital. Dr. Sullivan (Shawnee Smith) is assigned to determine if his wild stories are true. A trip to Jake's apartment convinces her that they are, and Sullivan soon discovers that the vengeful spirits Toshio (Shimba Tsuchiya) and Kayako (Aiko Horiuchi) have latched onto a new family. Only the mysterious Naoko (Emi Ikehata) knows how to stop them once and for all.

programme.title: The Descent
programme.desc: A year after a severe emotional trauma, Sarah (Shauna Macdonald) goes to North Carolina to spend some time exploring caves with her friends; after descending underground, the women find strange cave paintings and evidence of an earlier expedition, then learn they are not alone: Underground predators inhabit the crevasses, and they have a taste for human flesh.

programme.title: Taboo
programme.desc: An unknown killer stalks six friends one year after they played a provocative parlor game.

programme.title: Flight 7500
programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers.

programme.title: Dark Ride
programme.desc: Ten years have passed since the brutal murder of two teenage girls by a psychopath named Jonah. He escapes from the mental institution and returns to his old haunt, an amusement park with an attraction called "Dark Ride." Meanwhile, six friends on a road trip board the ride, not knowing of the deadly plans Jonah has in store.

programme.title: Unlikely Angel
programme.desc: A dead country singer (Dolly Parton) seeks to get into heaven by uniting a troubled family during the holidays.

programme.title: All You Ever Wished For
programme.desc: A fashion executive's trip to Milan takes a bad turn when he is kidnapped and held for ransom money. Little does he or his abductors know that the small cottage they end up spending the night in is under a gypsy love spell.

programme.title: Elvira's Haunted Hills
programme.desc: In the 19th century, a buxom woman (Cassandra Peterson) of mystery and shtick visits a castle inhabited by a fatally cursed family.

programme.title: The DUFF
programme.desc: Frumpy high-school senior Bianca (Mae Whitman) has a rude awakening when she learns that her classmates secretly know her as the DUFF -- designated ugly fat friend -- to her prettier and more popular pals. Desperate to reinvent herself, Bianca enlists the aid of Wesley (Robbie Amell), a charming jock. In order to save her senior year from becoming a complete disaster, Bianca must find the confidence to overthrow a judgmental student (Bella Thorne) and revolutionize the school's social order.

programme.title: She-Devil

programme.title: The Lazarus Effect
programme.desc: Medical researcher Frank (Mark Duplass), his fiancée Zoe (Olivia Wilde) and their team have achieved the impossible: they have found a way to revive the dead. After a successful, but unsanctioned, experiment on a lifeless animal, they are ready to make their work public. However, when their dean learns what they've done, he shuts them down. Zoe is killed during an attempt to recreate the experiment, leading Frank to test the process on her. Zoe is revived -- but something evil is within her.

programme.desc: A supernatural force terrorizes airline passengers.

programme.title: Cyborg 2: Glass Shadow
programme.desc: A cyborg designed to appear convincingly human, Casella "Cash" Reese (Angelina Jolie) is a spy and assassin for the massive Pinwheel Corporation. Set to ultimately self-destruct, Cash attempts to evade her fate with the aid of martial-arts expert and trainer Colson "Colt" Ricks (Elias Koteas) and a rebellious fellow cyborg named Mercy (Jack Palance). Naturally, the company doesn't want to lose one of their prize assets, so the ruthless Daniel Bench (Billy Drago) is sent to track Cash down.

programme.title: Invasion of the Body Snatchers
programme.desc: This remake of the classic horror film is set in San Francisco. Matthew Bennell assumes that when a friend complains of her husband's strange mood, it's a marital issue. However, he begins to worry as more people report similar observations. His concern is confirmed when writer Jack Bellicec and his wife discover a mutated corpse. Besieged by an invisible enemy, Bennell must work quickly before the city is consumed.

programme.title: Paradise Hills

programme.title: Bug
programme.desc: At a rundown desert motel, Agnes (Ashley Judd) begins a tentative relationship with a newcomer named Peter (Michael Shannon). He has a strange charisma, one that offers fearful and unstable Agnes a flicker of hope. When Peter reveals that the military deliberately infected him with a bug and that he has tiny insects crawling under his skin, paranoia begins to envelop the desperate pair.

When she's discovered by three vampire hunters, Vladimir (Michael Madsen), Katarin (Michelle Rodriguez) and Sebastian (Matt Davis), she manages to convince them to spare her life and join her cause. But slaying a vampire as powerful as Kagan will be no easy task.

programme.desc: The tale of a washed-up golf phenom who gets a job at a country club where catching a buzz is par for the course.

programme.desc: A birthday celebration exposes the fragile bond between two sisters. Dark secrets surface, unraveling the intricacies of their relationship and the profound impact of hidden truths on their lives.

programme.title: Worlds Apart
programme.desc: Set in modern-day Greece, Worlds Apart is comprised of three separate narratives, each following a love story between a foreigner and a Greek.

programme.title: Amber Road
programme.desc: The Amber Road is a place in the digital universe where anything can be bought, sold, and traded: a place where a person can fulfill their darkest desire or unleash their deepest depravity.

programme.title: Murder Loves Killers Too
programme.desc: A deranged man, whose version of sex is murdering people, hunts after a group of sexy teenagers.

programme.title: How to Eat Your Watermelon in White Company (and Enjoy It)
programme.desc: Melvin Van Peebles was one of the first black directors to challenge the white establishment in his films, which include "Watermelon Man" and "Sweet Sweetback's Baadasssss Song." In this documentary, the life of Van Peebles is discussed, including his work not only in film, but also as a novelist, actor, musician, stock trader and even Air Force pilot. Interview subjects include Gil Scott-Heron, Spike Lee and Melvin's son and fellow filmmaker, Mario Van Peebles.

programme.title: Decade of Fire
programme.desc: In the 1970s, fires consumed the South Bronx. Black and Puerto Rican residents were blamed, even as they fought to save their homes. Vivian Vázquez Irizarry pursues the truth around the fires, uncovering racist policies and neglect that shape our cities.

programme.title: Dirty Dilemma
programme.desc: In today's ever-changing dating landscape, can anyone truly claim to have a pure connection devoid of lies, secrets, and trust issues? For Malika and Kyrie, their love will be pushed to the brink as they face the ultimate test.

programme.title: Lynch: A History
programme.desc: Lynch: A History is a kaleidoscopic look at Marshawn Lynch's use of silence as a form of protest. Culling 700 clips and placing them in radical juxtaposition, the film is a powerful parable about American sports media and racial oppression.

programme.title: Instant Dreams
programme.desc: When Polaroid announced the end of instant film in 2008, many feared the chemical formula would be lost forever. Instant Dreams follows a number of quirky individuals who are connected to Polaroid, who work and create to keep the magic of instant film.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Molli and Max in the Future
programme.desc: A sci-fi rom-com about a man and woman whose orbits repeatedly collide over the course of 12 years, 4 planets, 3 dimensions, and 1 space-cult. Molli and Max in the Future combines character-driven romance with an eclectic sci-fi universe.

programme.title: Julien & Claire
programme.desc: When musician Julian and ballet dancer Claire meet on a bridge in Paris, the chance encounter accelerates their lives for a few days.

programme.title: Song Without Words
programme.desc: A street performer who never says a word begins to change lives with his very special act.

programme.title: The Wall
programme.desc: A woman suddenly finds herself cut off from all human contact, when an invisible, unyielding wall surrounds the countryside where she is vacationing.

programme.title: A New Year's Ride
programme.desc: Two years after "The Christmas Ride," Georgia is back on the road to get some cash on New Years Eve. When an old flame turns up in her car, Georgia is faced with choices, emotions, and self doubt. What's next for her new year?

programme.title: Plots with a View
programme.desc: A woman, whose husband is cheating on her, and an undertaker, who has been in love with her since their childhood, decide to fake her death so they can be together.

programme.title: Code Duello: From The Tithebanner Saga
programme.desc: Following a cataclysmic collision of galaxies, two survivors navigate the strange new world where they find themselves, searching for a place in society to survive and build a new life together.

programme.title: Index Zero
programme.desc: 2035, a couple enters illegally in the United States of Europe. Here, an 'Index of Sustainability' is given to every citizen, calculated on their personal productivity and wellbeing. She is pregnant and is 'not sustainable'. She must to be expelled.

programme.title: Saving Sally
programme.desc: Marty, a comic book artist, falls for his saviour Sally, a feisty gadget inventor. Afraid Sally might be getting abused by her adoptive parents, Marty strives to save her.

programme.title: Upstairs Inferno
programme.desc: For over 40 years, the 1973 New Orleans gay bar arson was considered the "Largest Gay Mass Murder in US History." Featuring heart-wrenching interviews with survivors, friends of victims, and witnesses, the film vividly examines the forgotten tragedy.

programme.title: An Honest Liar
programme.desc: The incredible true story of the renowned magician turned skeptic and exposer of frauds and hoaxes, James "The Amazing" Randi.

programme.title: Get Close
programme.desc: Tony Turner loses his father while in prison due to health issues. When he leaves prison, he meets a young lady named Kimaya, who he begins to fall in love with but refuses to allow her in, all while ducking the guy whose drugs he went to prison for.

programme.title: Target List
programme.desc: After announcing a ground-breaking cancer cure, five research team members are targeted by an assassin hired by big pharma. Two researchers soon find themselves framed for the crime and on the killer's target list when they escape the attack.

programme.title: When I Walk
programme.desc: The film follows award-winning filmmaker Jason DaSilva during the seven years following his diagnosis of primary progressive multiple sclerosis.

programme.title: Spine Tingler: The William Castle Story
programme.desc: Throughout the 1950's and 60's, William Castle produced and directed horror films marked by their outrageous gimmicks. This documentary is about his rags-to-riches tale of exploitation and self-promotion, yet a man privately plagued by a fear of failure.

programme.title: The Defective Detectives
programme.desc: Shree, Aditya and Manav are Blind, Deaf and Dumb respectively. They start a detective agency. Their first client is Maria, who has been conned by Ganesh Dsouza of her ancestral property. Now the trio with their special skills, solve this impossible case.

programme.title: Brothers From Malta
programme.desc: Denounced Maltese brothers Joe and Charlie must break their 7-year silence when they're forced to road-trip across California with a flatulent canine and precious family heirloom to rescue their dying sister.

programme.title: To Kill With Intrigue
programme.desc: The Honeybee Flower gang kills everyone in Lei mansion but Siao Lei, spared by their leader because she likes him.

programme.title: Escape to Athena
programme.desc: A ragtag group of prisoners -- Italian chef Bruno (Sonny Bono), British archeology professor Blake (David Niven), American soldier Nat (Richard Roundtree) and Greek prostitute Elena (Claudia Cardinale) -- befriend each other in a Greek POW camp run by Otto Hecht (Roger Moore), an art-loving Nazi officer. With the help of local resistance fighters, the inmates plot to escape and steal valuable artifacts from a heavily guarded monastery that's used as a storehouse.

programme.title: Candy
programme.desc: A fatherly chemistry professor (Geoffrey Rush) indulges two young lovers (Heath Ledger, Abbie Cornish) in their ever-increasing heroin habits. Eventually the pair, an artist named Candy and an aspiring poet named Dan, become caught in a harrowing downward spiral of drug dependency and failed efforts to get clean.

programme.title: Joe Strummer: The Future Is Unwritten
programme.desc: Julien Temple's film is a fitting tribute to one of Britain's most influential and best-loved musicians, best known as the frontman of The Clash, who mellowed in later life into fronting his new band, the Mescaleros. Temple's advantage is that as a chronicler of punk from its earliest days, he could call on his own archive footage as well as that shot by others over the years.

programme.title: Suburbia
programme.desc: An overwhelming sense of despair impels a teenager to leave his suburban home and join up with a group of punk rockers.

programme.title: The Decline of Western Civilization Part III
programme.desc: In this documentary, filmmaker Penelope Spheeris captures the life of Los Angeles "gutter punks": homeless teenagers who prefer anarchy and chaos to organized society. Many of the film's subjects come from abusive households and have developed alcohol and drug problems. While living on the streets, they must panhandle, squat in abandoned apartment buildings and fight off skinheads to survive. The film also includes performances by several notable Los Angeles punk bands.

programme.title: Sea Fever
programme.desc: Solitary marine-biology student Siobhán endures a week on a ragged fishing trawler, miserably at odds with the close-knit crew. But out in the deep Atlantic, an unfathomable life-form soon ensnares the boat. As members of the crew now succumb to a strange infection, Siobhán must overcome her alienation and win their trust -- before everyone is lost.

programme.title: Security

The two develop a powerful and inspirational relationship in which they discover truths that take most people a lifetime to learn.

programme.title: On Golden Pond

This year, their adult daughter, Chelsea (Jane Fonda), visits with her new fiancée and his teenage son, Billy (Doug McKeon) on their way to Europe. After leaving Billy behind to bond with Norman, Chelsea returns, attempting to repair the long-strained relationship with her aging father before it's too late.

programme.title: Magic

When the unbalanced Corky fears he won't pass the required mental exam, he runs away with Fats to his hometown, where he meets an old love from high school, Peggy (Ann-Margret). Corky persuades Peggy to leave her loveless marriage -- but Fats, who seems to be taking on a mind of his own, doesn't approve of the relationship.

Initially, Barb eggs the caller on, but stops when he responds threateningly. Soon, Barb's friend Clare (Lynne Griffin) goes missing from the sorority house, and a local adolescent girl is murdered, leading the girls to suspect a serial killer is on the loose. But no one realizes just how near the culprit is.

Among the artists included in the project are singer Ibrahim Ferrer and pianist Rubén González, who are both interviewed and featured in studio footage. Eventually the ensemble travels to the United States to perform in front of rapt audiences.

Against all odds, trucking and construction entrepreneur Charlie Walker secures a lucrative contract to clean the coastline. Dick (James Roday), for example, is a divorced and struggling salesman, and Dave (Jay Paulson) works at a gas station. Luckily, the Murphys' parents left them a map to a secret government marijuana field -- so Dick, Dave and their paraplegic brother, Dinkadoo (Sam Huntington), along with two friends, set off to find this legendary pot, which they hope to sell.

But when Utah falls in love with a female surfer, Tyler (Lori Petty), who is close to the gang, it complicates his sense of duty.

When his next story is about the drug trade taking place on the beach, Fletch goes undercover as a homeless man. Unaware of Fletch's true identity, businessman Alan Stanwyk (Tim Matheson) offers Fletch $50,000 to kill him. Intrigued, Fletch decides to unearth the full story behind the offer.

programme.title: Fletch Lives
programme.desc: Irwin "Fletch" Fletcher (Chevy Chase) is one of the best investigative reporters in the country, and he'll need all his skill when he becomes the main suspect in a murder case. After inheriting a Louisiana plantation from a distant relative, Fletch makes the journey from Los Angeles to check it out. When he winds up in bed with a lawyer -- who in turn winds up dead the next morning -- Fletch has to solve the crime before he ends up behind bars for someone else's misdeed.

programme.title: Problem Child
programme.desc: Ben is a good-hearted guy who's always wanted a son of his own, but so far he and his wife have had no success. The couple adopt Junior, a redheaded hellion who quickly makes their lives miserable. Disaster follows Junior wherever he goes, from camping trips that require emergency-room visits to birthday parties that turn into Grand Guignol affairs. When Ben's incensed family tells him to get rid of the boy, he starts to wonder if they might be right.

She outfits Gary and Wyatt in cool clothes, surprises them with a Porsche and helps them stand up to jerks Ian and Max. But, all the while, the boys must hide Lisa's existence from Chet, Wyatt's nightmare of a big brother.

programme.title: Gone
programme.desc: After decades of living on the run, murder suspect Frank O'Neal (Billy Burke) returns to Los Angeles hoping to put his derailed existence back on track. O'Neal reconnects with an old flame, Karen Mellor (Sherry Stringfield), and finds gainful employment as a driver for an armored truck service. But, as he falls under the influence of a maniacal televangelist (Gregory Itzin), the unsavory impulses behind O'Neal's return begin to surface, threatening to destroy him.

programme.title: The Darkness
programme.desc: Peter Taylor (Kevin Bacon), his wife Bronny and their two children return to Los Angeles after a fun-filled vacation to the Grand Canyon. Strange events soon start to plague the family, including young son Michael's increasingly erratic behavior. The Taylors learn that Michael brought back some mysterious rocks that he discovered inside a cave. Unfortunately, something followed them home as the clan now find themselves in a battle with a supernatural force that preys on their worst fears.

programme.title: Hanna
programme.desc: Raised by her father (Eric Bana) in the Finnish wilderness, teenage Hanna (Saoirse Ronan) has trained all her life to be the perfect assassin. Her father sends her on a mission, and she stealthily makes her way across Europe while evading agents sent after her by a ruthless operative named Marissa (Cate Blanchett), who once worked with Hanna's father. As she draws closer to her target, Hanna faces startling revelations about her existence and begins to question her humanity.

programme.title: Eastern Promises
programme.desc: Nikolai (Viggo Mortensen), who is both ruthless and mysterious, has ties to one of the most dangerous crime families in London. He crosses paths with Anna (Naomi Watts), a midwife who has come across potentially damaging evidence against the family, which forces him to set in motion a plan of deceit, death and retribution.

programme.title: Fighting
programme.desc: Shawn MacArthur (Channing Tatum) barely makes a living selling counterfeit goods on the streets of New York. But he has a natural talent for street fighting, which con-man Harvey Boarden (Terrence Howard) wants to put to good use. Forming an uneasy alliance with Boarden, Shawn becomes top dog in the bare-knuckle-brawl circuit, taking down pro boxers, martial artists and ultimate fighters one by one. Shawn wants out of this dark world, but he faces the fight of his life to get there.

programme.title: Sudden Death
programme.desc: Ex-fireman Darren McCord (Jean-Claude Van Damme) has a new job working security at the Pittsburgh Civic Arena. Hoping to impress his kids, he's scored tickets to the Stanley Cup Finals, unaware that the place has been taken over by a group of terrorists. Ex-CIA agent Joshua Foss (Powers Boothe) is holding the vice president hostage in a press box and plans to blow up the building if he doesn't pay the ransom. But, when Darren learns of his scheme, he jumps into action to save the day.

After the procedure, Damian, now called Edward (Ryan Reynolds), starts a new life in New Orleans, but he's plagued by disturbing images. programme.title: La La Land
programme.desc: Sebastian (Ryan Gosling) and Mia (Emma Stone) are drawn together by their common desire to do what they love. But as success mounts they are faced with decisions that begin to fray the fragile fabric of their love affair, and the dreams they worked so hard to maintain in each other threaten to rip them apart.

programme.title: Girl Most Likely
programme.desc: After losing her job and her boyfriend, a woman moves in with her estranged mother and finds an assortment of strange characters inhabiting the home.

programme.title: Silver Linings Playbook
programme.desc: After losing his job and wife, and spending time in a mental institution, Pat Solatano winds up living with his parents. He wants to rebuild his life and reunite with his wife, but his parents would be happy if he just shared their obsession with the Philadelphia Eagles. Things get complicated when Pat meets Tiffany, who offers to help him reconnect with his wife, if he will do something very important for her in exchange.

programme.title: The Skeleton Twins
programme.desc: Following many years of estrangement, twins Milo (Bill Hader) and Maggie (Kristen Wiig) have an unexpected reunion after a set of near-tragedies. The situation forces them to confront how their lives became so broken. For Maggie, it means examining why she's so unhappy in a marriage to a loving husband. For Milo, it means meeting with his first love to see if their romance can reignite. Eventually, they learn that living truthfully and accepting each other is the only way to move forward.

programme.title: Thanks for Sharing
programme.desc: A recovering sex addict (Mark Ruffalo) tries not to fall off the wagon as he woos a new girlfriend (Gwyneth Paltrow) who feels the need to express her rampant sexuality.

programme.title: A Simple Favor
programme.desc: Stephanie is a widowed single mother who works as a vlogger in Connecticut. Her best friend, Emily, seems to have it all, a successful career, a loving family and a glamorous lifestyle. When Emily mysteriously disappears one day, Stephanie launches her own investigation by digging into her friend's past, finding a few surprises along the way.

programme.title: Knives Out
programme.desc: The circumstances surrounding the death of crime novelist Harlan Thrombey are mysterious, but there's one thing that renowned Detective Benoit Blanc knows for sure -- everyone in the wildly dysfunctional Thrombey family is a suspect. Now, Blanc must sift through a web of lies and red herrings to uncover the truth.

programme.title: The Lincoln Lawyer
programme.desc: Mick Haller (Matthew McConaughey) is a charismatic defense attorney who does business out of his Lincoln Continental sedan. Mick spends most of his time defending petty crooks and other bottom-feeders, so it comes as quite a surprise when he lands the case of a lifetime: defending a Beverly Hills playboy (Ryan Phillippe) who is accused of attempted murder. However, what Mick initially thinks is an open-and-shut case with a big monetary reward develops into something more sinister.

programme.title: Brooklyn's Finest
programme.desc: A drug operation changes the lives of three conflicted New York cops. Burned-out vet Eddie Dugan is close to retirement; narcotics cop Sal Procida faces the difficult task of caring for his large family on his ordinary salary. Undercover officer Clarence Tango Butler finds his loyalties beginning to shift toward a powerful drug dealer. Over seven chaotic days, the three men are drawn toward a fateful crime and destiny.

programme.title: Killing Them Softly
programme.desc: When rival crook Johnny Amato (Vincent Curatola) hatches a plan to rob a card game run by mob lackey Markie (Ray Liotta), he picks a low-rent thug named Frankie (Scoot McNairy) to do the job. Frankie picks a less-than-ideal partner (Ben Mendelsohn) to help him, but despite their combined incompetence, they manage to make off with the mob's money. In retaliation, Markie's bosses hire Jackie Cogan (Brad Pitt), a mob enforcer, to eradicate those responsible.

programme.desc: Enjoy the best of summer, autumn and winter with Baby Einstein! Discover the familiar sights and sounds of the different seasons. Learn names of common objects associated with each through repetition and narration and see engaging images of whimsical toys that celebrate each. Discover the magic of each season from falling leaves, rolling beach balls and even snowmen.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby's First Sounds: Discoveries for Little Ears
programme.desc: Perhaps the sweetest sounds you'll ever hear are the babbles and coos that one day become ma-ma, da-da and I love you. Besides being music to your ears, these baby steps of language change everything as your little one discovers an exciting, powerful new way of relating to the world! Baby's First Sounds invites both of you to share these memorable moments: those precious ''firsts'' that come around once in your baby's lifetime.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Einstein: Let's Learn about Dogs, Cats and More
programme.desc: Meet Cats, Dogs, Birds, Bugs and Woodland Creatures! Learn simple words through narration and repetition. Meet all sorts of creatures from domestic kittens to jungle cats, puppies, big and small birds, butterflies, lady bugs, otters and deer!! See whimsical toys and puppets.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby's Favorite Places: First Words Around Town
programme.desc: As babies turn one year old, they continue to develop their communication skills. Meanwhile, with you as their guide, they also begin to explore the world beyond their front door. Baby's Favorite Places presents them with a playful introduction to 20 words for the names of familiar locations from the market, to the library, to the local park.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Wordsworth: First Words Around the House
programme.desc: As their communication skills continue to develop, little ones begin to recognize common words and may point to objects or pictures when these items are named. Baby Wordsworth playfully taps into your little one's natural curiosity and introduces 30 words from around the home -- both spoken and in sign language. This engaging program presents little ones with familiar objects in the kitchen, playroom, yard and more -- from the living room window to their favorite teddy bear.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.sub-title: Baby Da Vinci: From Head to Toe
programme.desc: From the day their eyes open, babies begin to observe new things around the world and about themselves. Baby Da Vinci From Head to Toe presents them with a playful and interactive introduction to the human body in three languages -- English, Spanish, and French. With a whimsical blend of adorable puppets, real children and animals and famous works of art, this captivating program also features upbeat classical music.

programme.title: Baby Einstein
programme.desc: With the Dolittle, and other Baby programs under their belts, the tots who follow Julie Aigner-Clark's Baby Einstein series will sidle up to Baby Newton expecting a similar exploration of building blocks to brilliance, but this time there's a wrinkle or two. Animation makes its first appearance, and parents steeped in keep-it-simple culture may object to the springy "I Know My Shapes" song, a departure from classical-only video predecessors.

programme.title: Marvel Black Panther Trouble in Wakanda
programme.desc: Being the King of Wakanda is tough -- especially when you're also the Black Panther! When Thanos arrives from outer space and threatens to destroy Earth, the Black Panther leaps into action and defeats him with the help of Earth's Mightiest Heroes. But the situation only gets worse when rogue villains Killmonger and Klaue team up with the Mad Titan to take the fight to Black Panther's homeland! Can the Panther pounce on their perilous plan before Wakanda is pulverized?

programme.title: The Maze Of Amazement
programme.desc: The Knights find themselves trapped in a maze looking for the Book of Deception. But will they actually get their hands on it, or will it keep deceiving them? The Knights travel to the Hill Country in the northern part of Knighton to Axl's home town of DIGGINGTON (where they realize that all of Axl's family look just like him.) While they're there, Merlok 2.0 detects something…one of the Magic Books! It's “The Book of Deception.” They go to find it and discover it ended up under a mountain. And, to make matters worse, the magic book has built a maze around itself to keep it from being found (it is deceptive!) As the NEXO-Knights enter the maze from one side, Jestro enters from the other the Book of Monsters has led him to the maze to get The Book of Deception, too. It's a race through this confusing maze to see who can get the book first. Ava figures out the maze is the Whackman maze from a videogame. After help from Axl's people to defeat Jestro and win the book, the knights discover it's a FAKE BOOK of deception. The Book of Deception created a fake copy of itself!

programme.title: The Hundred Year Moon
programme.desc: At the night of the Hundred Year Moon, the Wolves are running wild and causing havoc. Crooler kidnaps a young gorilla girl to lure Laval, Eris and Gorzan the Gorilla out to rescue her. It is a very dangerous night, but finally Skinnet the Skunk's foul odor may prove useful.

programme.title: Fish Story!
programme.desc: Vic and Owen find themselves, along with Sinjin, in the middle of a massive dino-fight in the old Jurassic Park Visitor Center.

programme.title: Snow Way
programme.desc: Practicing for the local snow lodge's big snowboard race, Mia has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no biggie, but when she tries to resume practice, the normally fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! At the local snow lodge's Snowboard Meet, ace snowboarder Mia, trying to raise money for a new Heartlake City animal shelter, enters the fiercest race of all – the Boardercross. Then, while practicing, she has an accident and hurts her ankle. She insists it's no big deal, but once she heals and tries to resume practice, the usually fearless Mia finds she's now terrified of snowboarding! With the help of her Friends, she tries hard to overcome her fear, but her nightmarish visions of snowboard monsters and jeering snowmen have her shaking in her bed. She backs out of the race, disappointing her Friends and herself. Finally, when an avalanche traps Fiona, Mia is forced to overcome her fears and race to the rescue.

programme.title: The Royal Blacksmiths

programme.title: Marvel Superheroes

programme.title: The Book Of Total Badness
programme.desc: The NEXO-Knights must fight Jestro's Monsters of Destruction which are attacking all over the Kingdom. But Merlok smells a trap…is he right? In a dark, destroyed part of the kingdom, Jestro arrives at the ruins of a HUGE castle. The Book of Monsters knows this place: the great evil wizard Monstrux lived here. The Book sniffs out some powerful magic in the ruins: “The Book of Destruction.” With this, The Book tells Jestro they can destroy the NEXO-Knights and then attack the King's Castle and cause massive destruction. Jestro creates destructive monsters and sends them all over the realm, so the Knights must separate and fight single combats all over the place. The Knights lose these battles (lesson: they have to work as a team!) And, just when the Knights are scattered across the Kingdom, Jestro attacks the King's Castle! It looks like all is lost. When Aaron, who has escaped, returns to see Jestro's attack, he realizes he must gather his fellow Knights.
